Error: nu::parser::shell_outerr

  x The '2>&1' shell operation is 'out+err>' in Nushell.
   ,-[source:1:28]
 1 | ls 'D:/definitely-missing' 2>&1 | select name
   :                            ^^|^
   :                              `-- use 'out+err>' instead of '2>&1' in Nushell
   `----
  help: Nushell redirection will write all of stdout before stderr.
